ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Beneficial Owner Information Administrative Measures issued by the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024); Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (as revised in 2024); Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign shareholder/parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent incorporation authority in the investor's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel exclusive paths: (1) Hague Apostille state - original certificate, where necessary notarially certified by the local notary, then issued an Apostille by the designated Competent Authority in the origin jurisdiction, then sworn Chinese translation for Chinese authorities; (2) Non-Apostille state - original certificate notarized, then legalized by the origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent, then authenticated by the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, then sworn Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are never chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status of the foreign shareholder/parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or registrar of companies in the investor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Same mutually exclusive path as above: Apostille for Apostille Convention member states; consular legalization for non-member states; followed by sworn Chinese translation. The certificate should be dated within 30 days of request and clearly state that the entity is active and in good standing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution appointing the legal representative, director(s), and authorized signatories of the WFOE and approving the incorporation and capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder/parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execute under board seal and signatures; notarize the corporate execution where necessary; then either attach a Hague Apostille for Apostille states or complete consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate for non-Apostille states; provide sworn Chinese translation. The resolution must clearly identify the WFOE name, registered capital, business scope, shareholders, first legal representative, and authorized agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Charter/Constitution) and share register of the foreign shareholder/parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry certified extract or registered corporate secretary/notary in the origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Use registry-certified copy or notarized extract; then authenticate exclusively either by Hague Apostille (member state) or by Chinese consular legalization (non-member state); append sworn Chinese translation. The share register is required to trace ownership to the natural-person ultimate beneficial owners.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the foreign shareholder/parent entity confirming satisfactory account operation and financial standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account relationship bank of the foreign shareholder/parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original letter on bank letterhead signed by an authorized bank officer; notarize the officer's signature if required by the bank or local practice; then apply either Hague Apostille (Apostille state) or consular legalization through the Chinese Embassy/Consulate (non-Apostille state); sworn Chinese translation must be attached for PRC bank and SAMR use. Apostille and consular legalization are alternatives and never sequential.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to filing, the proposed WFOE, its directors, legal representative, ultimate beneficial owners, and any shareholder acting as authorized signatory must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI sanctions regime, China Ministry of Public Security wanted/designated persons lists, PBOC anti-money laundering and suspicious transaction blacklist, SAMR serious-violation blacklist, the Supreme People's Court dishonest-debtor list, and commercial PEP/negative-news databases (e.g., World-Check). Any PEP match requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds documentation, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring for at least the first five years of the WFOE. Screening must be refreshed no more than 48 hours before submission and every month until the certificate of incorporation is issued.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System, accessed through the online service platform of the provincial/municipal Market Supervision Administration and linked to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory legal name must be composed solely of Mandarin Chinese characters under the four-tier structure: (1) administrative division (province/municipality or district), (2) distinctive trade name (which may be a phonetic transliteration of the foreign parent's brand into Chinese characters), (3) industry or business scope expression (e.g., intelligent household appliance manufacturing), and (4) legal form suffix, namely limited liability company or the equivalent under the Company Law. Romanized pinyin or English-only names are insufficient for registration; an English name is optional and may be set out in the articles. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to a registered or approved name in the same or related industry and must comply with State Council Order No. 734 (2020) and the Administrative Measures for Enterprise Name Registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: There is no automatic statutory extension; before the 30-day reservation expires, the applicant must file the formal incorporation application or re-declare a new name. If the name is rejected, the applicant must retrieve the written electronic rejection notice stating the exact conflict or prohibited token, correct the company name, and submit a fresh self-declaration. If the applicant disputes the rejection, an administrative reconsideration must be filed with the superior Market Supervision Administration or the local People's Government within 60 days of the rejection date; if the reconsideration decision is adverse or ignored, an administrative lawsuit may be filed with the competent court within 6 months. During appeal, preserve the original rejection notice, all name proof documents, and translation certificates, and obtain written confirmation from the registry before incurring further costs.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office, commercial mailbox, or letterhead-only address is not acceptable as the sole registered address for a manufacturing WFOE. The SAMR business license requires a physical Chinese commercial address in the registered district; the tax authority rejects virtual addresses for VAT invoice quota assignment and routine address verification; and the bank rejects virtual offices for opening the basic deposit account and RMB settlement facilities. For a robotic vacuum appliance manufacturer, the registered office must be supported by a lease agreement for actual office/production space, the property ownership certificate or rental permit, and visible operational substance (staff desks, equipment, storage, electrical and assembly facilities). A registered agent's address may only supplement, not replace, the physical registered premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high during the first 12 months, quantified at approximately 25-35% annual probability due to SAMR's double random, one open inspection system and tax bureau address verification for newly established WFOEs. Checklist on inspection: original business license, lease contract, property rights certificate or land-use permit, rental and utility invoices, payroll and social insurance records, inventory and fixed assets, fire-safety and

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), effective 1 July 2024, Articles 3, 4, 8, 10, 23, 27-33, 35, 43, 46-47, 59-60 and 63; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 3, 4 and 28; Implementing Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law, Articles 4 and 8; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (2021), Chapters 1-4.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation, acting through the local Administration for Market Regulation in the municipal or district-level jurisdiction where the WFOE registered office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form (with Articles of Association), submitted through the enterprise registration single-window system of the local Administration for Market Regulation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise Limited Liability Company under PRC law. The sole shareholder must subscribe the registered capital stated in the Articles of Association and must actually pay in full within five years from establishment, unless a shorter contribution period is required by a specific PRC law or administrative regulation. No blocked escrow account is mandated. The contribution must be remitted from lawful overseas funds into the WFOE's designated foreign settlement or RMB capital account at a PRC-licensed bank after completing the foreign exchange information registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the designated bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [●] WFOE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, CHINA - FIRST DULY CONVENED BOARD MEETING. WHEREAS, the sole shareholder has adopted the Articles of Association of the Company and elected the undersigned directors to constitute the first board of directors; and WHEREAS, the board is required to complete the statutory organization of the Company, including share capital subscription, banking arrangements, registered office adoption, and appointment of statutory officers; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION. The board records and confirms that the sole shareholder has subscribed to the entire registered capital of the Company in the amount of CNY [●], comprised of [●] equity interests at a nominal value of CNY [●] each. The General Manager is directed to open a dedicated capital contribution collection account, to verify receipt of each contribution installment, to issue the statutory capital contribution receipt, and to maintain the capital contribution ledger in accordance with the Company Law of the PRC and the Articles of Association. 2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE. The board adopts as the registered office and principal place of business of the Company the premises located at [●], China. The General Manager shall each year obtain and verify the lease agreement, property ownership certificate or sublease confirmation required by law, and shall ensure that all statutory notices, summons, and official correspondence may be lawfully served at that address. 3. BANKING AUTHORISATION. The board authorizes the opening with PRC-licensed banks of one basic deposit account, one general deposit account, and one foreign exchange capital account. All bank accounts, payment instruments, letters of credit, and electronic fund transfers shall require dual signature authority, namely the General Manager and one other director. The authorized signatories are instructed to complete client due diligence, anti-money-laundering screening, and tax identification formalities immediately upon account opening. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. The board appoints [●] as General Manager, [●] as Legal Representative, and [●] as Supervisor of the Company. The Legal Representative is authorized, jointly or singly with the General Manager as required by banking mandates, to sign, submit, and execute all corporate documents, government filings, contracts, and compliance instruments. The Supervisor shall independently review the financial affairs and supervise the directors and officers for compliance with PRC law. 5. CORPORATE SEALS AND MATERIALS. The board directs the General Manager to apply, at a public-security-approved engraving unit, for the company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, invoice seal, and contract seal, and to record all engraved seals with the public security authorities and the relevant Market Regulation bureau. 6. DELEGATION FOR STATUTORY LICENSING AND OPERATIONAL START-UP. The board authorizes the Legal Representative and General Manager, within the limits of law and this resolution, to perform post-incorporation formalities, including tax registration, social insurance registration, foreign exchange registration, environmental impact assessment, pollutant discharge permitting, fire-protection acceptance, civil defense inspection, and compulsory product certification for the manufacture of robotic vacuum appliances. This resolution is effective immediately, is binding on all directors, officers, and agents, and may be modified only by a subsequent vote of the board or a decision of the sole shareholder in accordance with PRC law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration Enterprise Name Search and Name Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation via the National Enterprise Name Registration Online Notification Application, administered by the local Administration for Market Regulation in the proposed residence jurisdiction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor, acting through its lawful counsel or local formation agent, shall submit four to six proposed trade names in the mandatory format of administrative division plus trade name plus industry plus limited liability company. Before submission, legal counsel must conduct a similarity search against the national enterprise name database and a trademark conflict search in the China Trademark Office record. The online system will generate electronic receipt and, if the name is available, an Enterprise Name Pre-Registration Notice. The notice is valid for use in the subsequent establishment application and must be filed before the statutory registration form is accepted.
required_dossiers: Completed enterprise name pre-registration application form
Proposed Chinese and English name list in ranked order
Certificate of incorporation or business registration certificate of the foreign investor
Power of attorney appointing the local formation agent
Passport or legal-identity document of the person who will serve as legal representative
Foreign investor financial-credit statement, if requested by the registration authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected for similarity, confusion, prohibited character, or political sensitivity, the applicant shall promptly submit a new alternative name list. Where the rejection is issued on grounds that the applicant considers incorrect, the applicant may request a written statement of reasons and file an administrative reconsideration with the competent Administration for Market Regulation within the statutory time limit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Apostille, and Certified Translation of Foreign Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Foreign notarial authorities, PRC approved translation agencies, and, where applicable, the competent authority for Hague Apostille certificates in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction; Chinese government departments accept apostille under the Hague Apostille Convention which entered into force for China on 7 November 2023.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All documents establishing the identity, good standing, and authority of the foreign shareholder must be notarized in the country of origin. If the foreign investor's jurisdiction is party to the Hague Apostille Convention, the notarized document must be authenticated by an apostille certificate; traditional consular legalization is no longer required. The certified documents and all corporate governance instruments must be translated into Chinese by a qualified translator or recognized translation service, with the Chinese version made controlling for registration purposes. The Articles of Association must be dated, signed by the sole shareholder, and sealed or executed consistent with foreign-law formalities and PRC practice.
required_dossiers: Notarized certificate of incorporation or equivalent business registration document of the foreign investor
Apostille certificate issued by the competent foreign authority, or PRC consular legalization if the jurisdiction is not apostille-participating
Notarized power of attorney executed by the foreign investor
Certified Chinese translation of all notarized and apostilled documents
Bank reference letter for the foreign investor, if required
Certified true copy of the passport of the designated legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an apostille or notarial certificate is rejected for formal deficiency, counsel shall arrange for the sovereign authority to reissue the certificate with corrected seal placement or jurat. If the Chinese translation is considered inconsistent with the source document, the applicant shall submit a revised translation accompanied by an affidavit of translator accuracy and, if necessary, a supplementary notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic and Physical Filing for WFOE Establishment and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation in the district or municipal seat of the registered office, accessed through the provincial government integrated service online portal and accepting physical documents at the corresponding service hall.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Counsel shall complete the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form, insert all shareholder, director, supervisor, legal representative and registered address information, and upload electronically the notarized and apostilled documents, Articles of Association, and the name approval notice. After preliminary electronic review, the physical dossier must be presented with original signatures. The registration authority verifies compliance with the negative-list provisions of the Foreign Investment Law and, upon satisfactory review, issues the Business License for an Enterprise Legal Person. The WFOE is deemed incorporated as of the date and hour printed on the license. The applicant must also file the foreign investment information report through the single-window system at the same time, as required by the Ministry of Commerce information-reporting rules.
required_dossiers: Duly signed Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form
Enterprise Name Pre-Registration Notice
Articles of Association executed by the sole shareholder
Lease agreement and property ownership certificate or legal use certificate for the registered office
Appointment documents for directors, legal representative, general manager, and supervisor
Valid passport or identity document of the legal representative and other statutory officers
Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Power of attorney and identification of the formation agent, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned with a rectification notice, the applicant shall cure the formal, signature, or document defect within the specified supplementary-filing period, usually fifteen working days, and resubmit through the online system. If the registration authority rejects the establishment on factual or legal grounds, the applicant may obtain a written refusal decision and bring an administrative reconsideration application or, in the alternative, commence administratively litigated review before a competent people's court. Production operations shall not commence before the Business License is properly obtained and all industrial licenses are in force.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation Statutory Set-up: Seals, Tax Registration, Social Insurance, Foreign Exchange Registration and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau for seal-engraving approval and seal-recording; State Taxation Administration for taxpayer and tax registration; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau for social insurance and housing fund registration; State Administration of Foreign Exchange supervised banks for FDI information registration; People's Bank of China for deposit account administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the Business License, the company shall procure the company seal, financial seal, tax invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal from a public-security-approved engraving workshop and record the seals in the Public Security seal database. The company must then complete tax recognition in the electronic tax bureau, including VAT and corporate income tax profiles, issue invoice entitlement, and register employees for social insurance and mandatory housing funds. Using the Business License and the notarized foreign shareholder documents, the company shall present the FDI information registration form to a PRC-listed settlement bank, which files the foreign exchange registration with SAFE and opens the foreign exchange capital account. In parallel, the company opens a basic deposit account with a bank of its selection after satisfying the commercial bank's client due diligence and anti-money-laundering verification. All accounts must be linked to the national tax and account-management information systems.
required_dossiers: Business License and original of the establishment registration notice
Articles of Association
Lease agreement and land/property title evidence
Legal representative and general manager passport or identity documents
Seal engraving application approved by Public Security
Tax registration supplementary information form
Foreign exchange FDI registration application prepared by the designated bank
PBOC general deposit account opening application and bank-required KYC forms
Social insurance and housing fund employer registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank refuses or delays account opening due to enhanced due-diligence concerns, the applicant shall provide updated beneficial-ownership declarations, source-of-funds evidence from the foreign investor, and corporate standing certificates. If SAFE registration is queried, the designated bank may resubmit the FDI information through the SAFE digital gateway; if the query persists, the applicant may contact the local administration of foreign exchange through the bank for an integrity confirmation. Late tax registration exposes the company to late-filing penalties, but voluntary correction, full disclosure, and prompt compliance with the electronic tax bureau notification will ordinarily mitigate administrative discretion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment, Pollutant Discharge Permit, Fire-Safety Acceptance and Product Compulsory Certification Prior to Manufacturing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal or district Ecology and Environment Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Department; local Administration for Market Regulation in cooperation with China Quality Certification Center for compulsory product certification; and the provincial Emergency Management Department for workplace safety and occupational-health filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: No industrial production equipment or robotic-vacuum assembly line may be commissioned until the environmental impact assessment procedure has been completed under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment classification catalogue. The WFOE shall retain a qualified EIA consultant to identify all emissions, wastewater streams, soldering fume, plastic injection molding thermal-decomposition products, noise, and hazardous waste. For a modern small-appliance manufacturing and assembly facility, the project will generally require an EIA report form, or an environmental registration form if the facility performs only passive assembly without soldering, coating, or surface treatment. After EIA acceptance, the company applies for the fixed-source pollutant discharge permit where the facility emits in excess of de minimis thresholds. Simultaneously, counsel must apply for fire-protection design review and completion acceptance for the factory and warehouse, obtain any civil-defense inspection certificate for occupied floor area, and register special equipment. For robotic-vacuum appliances destined for the PRC market or for all exports claiming conformity with PRC compulsory standardization, the product must obtain China Compulsory Certification under the CCC catalogue for household electrical appliances, including electric shock, mechanical hazard, fire, radiation and performance testing.
required_dossiers: Feasibility study or project description, including raw materials, energy balance and process flow
Environmental impact assessment report form or registration form prepared by a qualified institution
Construction project fire-protection design review application and supporting drawings
Fire-protection completion acceptance application filed with the Fire and Rescue Department
Pollutant discharge permit application and pollutant-emission inventory
CCC certification application, test reports, and factory-inspection records for robotic vacuum appliance models
Hazardous waste management plan and qualified disposal-service contract
Occupational hazard effect evaluation report and emergency response plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA document is returned for supplementation, the applicant must submit the technical supplement within the authority's stated period, usually thirty days, and may request a pre-consultation session with the Ecology and Environment Bureau. If the pollutant discharge permit is denied, the applicant should identify the non-compliant discharge parameter, install abatement equipment, and resubmit. If fire-protection acceptance is conditionally approved, all defects must be cured before the factory is placed into production. If CCC certification fails, the product may not be manufactured for sale as a compliant good until engineering changes are made and retesting is successfully completed; the authority is the State Administration for Market Regulation and its designated certification bodies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation, the local Administration for Market Regulation, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment acting through the municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, and the local Fire and Rescue Department, coordinated through the one-window industrial licensing desk of the district or municipal government.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business License with industrial manufacturing scope covering the manufacture of household electrical and smart cleaning appliances; Fixed-Pollutant-Source Pollutant Discharge Permit; Construction Project Fire Protection Completion Acceptance or Filing Certificate; and China Compulsory Certification for the robotic vacuum cleaner product range.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment, administered locally by the district and municipal Ecology and Environment Bureaus through the National Environmental Impact Assessment Approval System.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Mandatory EIA Report Form for a manufacturing facility that includes plastic injection molding, printed-circuit-board soldering, surface finishing, or application of coatings; Environmental Registration only where the production line is confined to non-chemical, non-soldering physical assembly and packaging. The project must also receive the Fixed-Pollutant-Source Pollutant Discharge Permit if wastewater, VOCs, or hazardous waste quantities exceed de minimis thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to a municipal sewer must meet pH 6.5-9.5, COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L, and suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L under GB/T 31962-2015; if wastewater is discharged directly into a natural water body it must meet GB 8978-1996 Grade I limits of COD not exceeding 100 mg/L and ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 15 mg/L. Air emissions from soldering and injection molding process vents must meet NMHC not exceeding 60 mg/Nm³, fugitive non-methane total hydrocarbon at the plant boundary not exceeding 4.0 mg/m³, and particulate matter not exceeding 120 mg/Nm³, in accordance with GB 16297-1996 and GB 37822-2019. Hazardous waste, including spent solder, flux residues, waste batteries, grease, and contaminated packaging, must be stored separately in a labelled, sealed, and hardened-cover hazardous-waste storage room and transferred only to licensed hazardous-waste disposal operators under a paper and electronic manifest system, with on-site storage not exceeding one year.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The factory building, warehouse, and ancillary structures must obtain fire-protection design review and final acceptance or fire-protection filing certification from the local Fire and Rescue Department, verifying structural load, exit capacity, fire-resistance rating, alarm and sprinkler protection, ventilation, and smoke-control systems in accordance with GB 50016. Civil-defense authorities must issue a civil-defense compliance certificate for any underground space or for projects above the applicable defense-density threshold. Occupational safety and health clearance must be obtained through a workplace safety pre-evaluation and a control-effect evaluation under the Law on Work Safety and the Law on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases, including noise-exposure monitoring, soldering-fume control, ergonomic handling, and emergency response drills, before employees are permitted to work.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), acting through provincial, municipal and county tax service bureaus; online filing is through the national Unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portal at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn, with export transaction data interfaced through the General Administration of Customs (GACC) and the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) whose parent is a foreign non-resident entity, the PRC statutory taxpayer identity is obtained as follows. The WFOE must first register with the local State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain a Business License bearing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the WFOE's Tax Identification Number for income tax, VAT, and customs/export tax refund purposes. Within 30 days after the Business License is issued, the WFOE must complete online tax registration in the Unified Electronic Tax Bureau, submitting the USCC, registered address, legal representative and financial officer identity details, paid-in or subscribed capital, bank account, business scope, customs registration, and VAT taxpayer classification. The foreign non-resident shareholder does not need a separate PRC TIN solely for holding equity; however, the WFOE must register the non-resident shareholder for withholding tax reporting in the Electronic Tax Bureau before remitting outbound dividends, royalties, interest, or service fees. A foreign non-resident enterprise with no Chinese establishment that earns China-source income is assigned a non-resident tax registration code by the local STA office upon contract filing. For export operations, the WFOE must additionally complete Foreign Trade Operator registration and Customs Declaring Entity registration with the GACC through the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None - the PRC has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime. The only relevant statutory election is the VAT taxpayer status election: when annual taxable sales are below the CNY 5,000,000 threshold, a small-scale taxpayer may voluntarily register as a General VAT Taxpayer; once elected, the entity can only revert after twelve months. There is no entity classification pass-through election for a WFOE.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 of taxable turnover (excluding VAT) within any consecutive 12-month period; exceeding this amount makes registration as a General VAT Taxpayer mandatory. Below this threshold the taxpayer is normally classified as a small-scale taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The PRC VAT system operates through the STA's VAT Invoice Management System and the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice platform. For all B2B and export transactions, invoice issuances are transmitted electronically to the tax authority in near-real time through the Unified Electronic Tax Bureau; each issued invoice receives a unique invoice code, QR code and tax-control digital signature. API-based integration is mandatory for high-volume issuers; paper invoices, where still permitted, must be generated through a tax-control device (Tax U-Key) with encrypted fiscal stamping. The export VAT invoice is cross-matched with the GACC export declaration and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) export collection data. The system also includes real-time red-letter invoice reporting, invoice authenticity verification, and automated risk warnings; any batch invoice that fails validation is blocked from issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of robotic vacuum appliances by the WFOE qualify for 0% VAT if the goods are actually exported from mainland China through a formal customs export declaration made in the WFOE's own name and customs registration; the WFOE is a General VAT Taxpayer and Foreign Trade Operator; the export sale is supported by a genuine cross-border contract, invoice, packing list, and transport document evidencing physical export; the export proceeds are collected from the foreign buyer in foreign currency and repatriated through the Chinese banking/SAFE system within the prescribed deadline; and the export declaration value, HS classification, and commodity description are accurate. The 0% rate applies to the export sale itself, with input VAT attributable to the exported goods refundable or retained as export tax rebate. Qualifying services such as offshore digital services are not part of this goods-based export dossier.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (export clearance form filed via the China International Trade Single Window)
Full set of ocean Bills of Lading or Air Waybills with the WFOE shown as exporter/shipper
Export sales contract or purchase order with the foreign buyer and Incoterms
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
Export VAT invoice (ordinary VAT invoice issued for export sales through the VAT Invoice Management System)
Foreign exchange collection and settlement confirmation reflected in SAFE's Trade in Goods Foreign Exchange Monitoring System (bank remittance advice or export proceeds collection certificate)
Any applicable export licence/certificate for restricted goods, if the specific robotic vacuum model requires it
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, GACC and SAFE conduct automated cross-checking of export declarations, invoice data, logistics records, and foreign exchange receipts before and after export tax refund approval. If zero-rating is not substantiated, the export is recharacterised as a domestic taxable sale and VAT is recaptured at 13% with daily late-payment interest at 0.05% per day. False refund claims trigger clawback of refunded VAT plus administrative fines ranging from 50% to 5 times the evaded tax under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection; fraudulent export tax refund is a criminal offence under the PRC Criminal Law, punishable by imprisonment and fines. In fraud cases, tax assessment and clawback are not time-limited, and the taxpayer may be placed on the serious dishonesty list, lose export tax refund qualification, and have customs credit rating downgraded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) as the central bank, with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the delegated national foreign exchange control and cross-border payment regulatory authority
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Under China's current-account convertibility regime, RMB is freely convertible for trade and service payments once the bank completes genuine transaction verification; capital-account transactions remain controlled and are permissible only on listed exogenous grounds after SAFE registration or approval. A Mainland WFOE may receive foreign equity funding into a SAFE-registered capital account, convert it in the bank's FX settlement pool, and retain RMB liquidity domestically, but it cannot freely move RMB offshore. Profit remittance to the overseas shareholder is an income-account payment requiring the WFOE's audited financial statements, board/shareholder distribution resolution, tax settlement certificate and a bank real-trade/income verification, with no separate annual reinvestment quota applicable after 2010 but still subject to tax clearance. Dividends must derive from after-tax earnings; the WFOE must comply with withholding tax and provide proof of payment. In practice, the convertibility hurdle arises not from absence of currency but from documentary exactness: wrong purpose code, mismatched customs data, invoicing discrepancies, or unregistered SAFE records cause bank rejection. Treasury teams should pre-map all payments to national-purpose codes and maintain consistent cross-border documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE Goods Trade Administration, export foreign currency proceeds must be repatriated to and declared in China through a designated domestic bank within 90 days after the date of customs export declaration, or within the extended approved credit term where the sales contract supports a longer collection period and SAFE has accepted the trade monitoring file. There is no mandatory conversion ratio: the WFOE may retain 100 percent of export proceeds in a domestic foreign-currency current account or voluntarily convert them into RMB at market rates. Each receipt is screened by the receiving bank against customs and SAFE electronic trade data, with matching export declaration numbers, invoice amounts and payment parties; overdue or unmatched receipts are flagged as trade FX monitoring exceptions and can trigger SAFE inquiry before the next settlement is cleared.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Foreign Exchange Escrow Account plus RMB Basic Operational Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: SAFE Foreign Exchange Capital Account plus Basic Operational RMB Account
Capital Verification Foreign Exchange Account plus Operational Current Account for trade settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs and fintech banking platforms are not licensed deposit-taking institutions under PBOC or NFRA and are legally barred from opening or maintaining RMB demand deposit accounts for Mainland-domiciled entities. Such EMIs cannot complete SAFE FDI registration, issue a legal capital account, match Chinese tax identity, or satisfy cross-border current-account repatriation and payment-filing obligations for a WFOE. They may be used only as ancillary offshore receivables aggregators for sales booked by an overseas affiliate, but all conversion and repatriation into the WFOE must route through a licensed domestic commercial bank. Viability Rating: Low as a primary treasury banking rail; Medium only as a supplementary collection module for offshore e-commerce revenue that is subsequently swept to China via a compliant trade payment file.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The legal representative of the WFOE must appear physically in-branch at least once for the initial Basic RMB Deposit Account opening under the PBOC RMB Bank Settlement Account Administration Measures. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted as the sole onboarding channel. For non-resident directors who cannot travel, banks will accept an authorized local finance officer with a notarized and consular-apostilled power of attorney, original corporate chop, board resolution appointing the authorized signatory, and the legal representative's passport copy, but branch-level face-to-face verification of an individual officer is still mandatory before the account becomes operational. For the SAFE foreign-exchange capital account, the WFOE must first complete FDI foreign-exchange registration and present the business license, unified social credit code certificate, and original seat seals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership chain obscured by multiple intermediate holding companies in offshore jurisdictions, preventing the bank from identifying the ultimate natural person with actual control over the WFOE.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a notarized corporate ownership audit covering every entity in the chain, including certificates of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, issued share registers, bearer-share declarations, and a full group organizational chart; submit signed UBO declarations for each ultimate natural person, passport copies, sanctions and adverse media search results, existing bank reference letters from the parent company's main bank, and a board resolution confirming the WFOE's management control.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected round-tripping or trade-based money-laundering exposure from over/under-invoiced capital injections or future OEM trade flows between related parties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare audited financial statements of the offshore parent for the last two financial years, independent asset valuation or business plan supporting the capital need, shareholder board resolutions detailing the exact capital injection amount and permitted use, source-of-funds evidence including bank statements, investment liquidation contracts, sale agreements, or legitimate loan facilities, and original SWIFT MT103 confirming remitter and beneficiary identity; for trade flows, append purchase orders, end-customer sales contracts, OEM component supplier agreements, and price comparables showing arm's-length margins.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and adverse media residual hits from name-only or same-name screening on the WFOE, ultimate beneficial owner, subsidiary, or traders, causing the bank compliance committee to block onboarding pending enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a dedicated enhanced due-diligence pack: commercial database screening output from a recognized provider such as LSEG/Refinitiv, Dow Jones, or World-Check with each hit explained and resolved as false positive; UN, EU, OFAC, and PRC sanctions list searches; litigation, bankruptcy, regulator enforcement, and political-exposure searches; detailed resume and industry references for the principals; physical registered-office proof; and a written business rationale for any shared names, addresses, or common suppliers with a flagged universe.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-data mismatch caused by e-commerce payment processors remitting export proceeds from a named payor different from the customs-declared customer, undermining the bank's trade verification obligation under SAFE rules.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an order-level reconciliation report from the marketplace or payment processor showing the WFOE as the settlement recipient, the aggregated amount matching multiple customer payments, the corresponding customs declarations and bills of lading for robotic vacuum units shipped, tax invoices, export VAT rebate vouchers, customer purchase records, logistics receipts, warehouse handover documents, and a signed explanation of the payment-splitting mechanism; maintain a rolling monthly reconciliation pack for the bank's trade team.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital from the overseas shareholder must be wired from the parent bank to the WFOE's SAFE-registered capital account at a licensed domestic bank using SWIFT MT103. The remitter name in the wire must exactly match the shareholder recorded in the WFOE's FDI foreign-exchange registration, and the payment purpose in the remittance instruction must be mapped by the receiving bank to the SAFE International Income and Payments declaration category for foreign direct investment capital contribution. The bank will credit the capital account, verify the beneficiary account number sealed in SAFE's FDI system, confirm that no prepayment or borrowing balance creates mismatch, and then allow FX settlement into RMB only after the WFOE submits its unified social credit code, business scope certificate, and the capital account payment-use negative-list confirmation. A certified public accountant must later issue a capital verification report confirming the registered capital has been fully paid in using lawful FX receipt and settlement records. The settled RMB may be used for payroll, raw materials, utilities, rent, taxes, and permitted operating expenses; it cannot be applied to domestic equity investment, entrusted loans, securities, or real-estate speculation outside the current-risk-control list.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade payments for imported components, royalty, after-sales service fees, and approved balance-of-payments items should be cleared through the WFOE's domestic current account using SWIFT MT103 for hard-currency transfers or the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System for RMB invoicing. For procurement under letters of credit, the bank issues an irrevocable documentary credit transmitted by SWIFT MT700 under UCP 600, with the exporter presenting compliant documents for payment. For smaller durable shipments, documentary collections on DP or DA terms may be processed under ICC URC 522, with the bank acting as collection agent and matching transport documents, invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and inspection certificates to the customs declaration. All outbound transactions must be covered by genuine underlying contracts and captured in SAFE's electronic trade monitoring system; the bank will require customs declarations, bills of lading or air waybills, tax invoices, and payment purpose codes before approving FX purchase or RBM cross-border clearing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/USD and RMB/EUR forward contracts are permitted for WFOEs to hedge genuine current-account trade exposures and approved capital-account exposures, with tenor and notional capped by the verified underlying transaction evidence and bank counterparty credit lines.

Cross-currency swaps are allowed only where the swap serves a registered cross-border loan, FDI capital flow, or SAFE-approved debt servicing schedule, and cannot be used as standalone speculation or to circumvent capital controls.

Onshore RMB non-deliverable forwards are not permitted for Mainland-domiciled WFOEs; offshore NDFs may be executed only through a foreign parent or overseas treasury center and must not create any onshore RMB settlement obligation.

FX options are permissible only as plain-vanilla hedges against existing current-account receipts or payments; premium must be market-consistent and the strategy must not embed a speculative sale or uncovered call on the RMB exchange rate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (Annual Report Filing) and Integrated Foreign Investment Information Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, jointly with the Ministry of Commerce for foreign-invested enterprise information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January through 30 June each year covering the immediately preceding fiscal year ending 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Filing after 30 June or failure to file results in inclusion in the List of Enterprises in Abnormal Operations within 10 working days; if the enterprise fails to publish an annual report for three consecutive years, SAMR places it on the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, imposes disqualification of legal representatives and senior managers for three years, and may ultimately revoke the business licence, effecting administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return including related-party transaction reporting forms
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration through the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of each year following the tax year (PRC tax year is the calendar year ending 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is punishable by a fine of RMB 2,000 to 10,000 or RMB 2,000 to 50,000 in serious cases; overdue tax accrues a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax, and underpaid tax is subject to an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid amount; persistent non-payment may lead to enforced collection against bank deposits and assets, and loss of tax credit status, though it does not directly trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual PRC Statutory Audit of Financial Statements by a Licensed Certified Public Accountant Firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial statements and independent auditor's report are delivered to the shareholders and retained at the registered office; copies are made available to SAMR, MOFCOM, the State Taxation Administration and other competent authorities upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. normally by 30 April, and no later than 31 May to align with the annual tax settlement filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to undertake the statutory audit may result in fines under the PRC Accounting Law of up to RMB 100,000 for the enterprise and RMB 5,000 to 100,000 for directly responsible personnel; the enterprise also risks abnormal-operations recording and rejection of annual filings when audited statements are required by SAMR or the tax authorities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transfer Pricing Documentation and Annual Related-Party Transaction Disclosure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration through the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Doctor/file and local file, where required, must be prepared and available by 31 May of each year simultaneously with the annual corporate income tax settlement; related-party transaction schedules are attached to the final settlement return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide timely and complete related-party transaction documentation permits the tax authority to make an assessed adjustment based on reasonable comparables, imposes a penalty of RMB 10,000 (RMB 50,000 in serious cases) under the Tax Collection Administration Law, and may trigger interest and an additional penalty of 50% to 500% on the adjusted tax liability.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE) enjoy a reduced 15% CIT rate; qualifying small low-profit enterprises may benefit from an effective 5% rate on taxable income up to RMB 3 million for 2023-2027; R&D expenses qualify for a 100% additional deduction (total 200% deduction); certain encouraged manufacturing industries in designated free trade zones or Hainan Free Trade Port may receive preferential 15% CIT treatment, but the robotic vacuum appliance WFOE must satisfy activity and revenue conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return of Resident Enterprises) filed via the State Taxation Administration electronic e-Taxation portal; quarterly provisional prepayments are filed on Form A200000 before being settled at year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., on or before May 31 of the following year for a calendar-year WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales of robotic vacuum appliances and spare parts, excluding VAT, less sales returns and discounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a WFOE, all worldwide income from operations is subject to China CIT as a resident enterprise. Where goods are exported to a related foreign distributor, invoice prices must be arm's length; under-invoicing creates a reportable TP adjustment and may trigger onshore deemed revenue recharacterization. Non-resident parent instructions are not entered on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs directly attributable to sales, including raw materials, outsourced motor and electronics assembly, labor, and manufacturing overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany procurement from non-resident suppliers must be priced under CUP, Cost Plus, or TNMM. Excessive amounts not supported by contemporaneous TP documentation are non-deductible; compliance with customs valuation is also expected. No direct non-resident tax declaration appears on this line, but the WFOE must disclose related-party transactions in the annual related-party reporting schedule attached to the A100000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, local education surcharges, property tax, stamp duty, and other business-related levies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: These are domestic taxes and generally unaffected by non-resident status. If the WFOE pays taxes on behalf of a non-resident contractor for installation or after-sales service, such deemed withholding is handled separately and must not be mixed with the WFOE's own CIT calculation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, e-commerce platform commissions, shipping, export logistics, trade fairs, and warranty expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Platform service fees paid to non-resident e-commerce operators may be characterized as royalties or service fees subject to 10% CIT WHT and VAT; the WFOE must withhold and remit. If the payee is a related party, the fee must satisfy the arm's-length standard and substantive benefit requirements. Expense without proper withholding is not automatically deductible and may trigger penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Management staff salaries, office rent, professional fees, R&D expenses before super deduction, and corporate overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees charged by a foreign headquarters must be supported by service contracts or cost-sharing arrangements and meet the benefit test under SAT Announcement 2017 No. 6; otherwise they are disallowed. R&D expenditures may be enhanced by a 100% additional deduction, but the R&D project must be substantively performed in China; outsourced R&D to related parties is subject to TP rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest on borrowings, bank fees, hedging costs, and other financing charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to a non-resident lender is subject to 10% WHT unless a treaty reduces it, and is non-deductible to the extent the related-party debt-to-equity ratio exceeds 2:1 under China's thin capitalization rules. The borrowing must have genuine commercial substance; excessive shareholder-loan interest disguised as equity may be recharacterized as a dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 7-8 (Boxes 7-8) - Asset Impairment Losses and Fair Value Changes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provision for inventory impairments, receivables, fixed assets, and changes in fair value of financial instruments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Impairments require strong evidence; tax authorities may reverse excessive provisions. For intercompany receivables owed by offshore affiliates, the loss is deductible only if reasonable collection efforts are demonstrated; if the affiliate's insolvency results from TP mispricing, the impairment may be disregarded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculated as revenue minus costs, selling, administrative and financial expenses, adjusted by impairment and fair value gains/losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is an internal checkpoint. If the WFOE's operating margin is disproportionately low compared with independent manufacturers of comparable smart appliances, the tax authority will challenge TP. Maintain a benchmarking report using Chinese comparable company data.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit plus non-operating income and minus non-operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-operating income includes foreign exchange gains and gains on disposals of assets. If a non-resident parent waives a debt without consideration, a deemed income may arise. Include any recharacterized related-party transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 14-15 (Boxes 14-15) - Tax Adjustment Increases and Decreases
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation of accounting profit to taxable income by adding back non-deductible items and deducting exempt income, previous-period losses, and incentive amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Key TP adjustments appear here: add back non-deductible related-party fees, excess interest, unsupported head-office allocations, and penalties; deduct treaty-exempt income, certain intercompany dividends from Chinese residents, and qualified R&D super-deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of qualified tax loss carryforwards applied to reduce taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may carry forward 5 years, or 10 years for qualified High and New Technology Enterprises. TP-adjusted losses that are artificial may be disallowed; the WFOE must prove that the loss year's intercompany pricing was arm's length and commercially rational.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 18-20 (Boxes 18-20) - Taxable Income and Tax Calculation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income multiplied by the statutory 25% CIT rate, or a reduced rate if the WFOE qualifies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident enterprise status means the foreign shareholder's non-resident status does not change the WFOE's tax rate. If the company is denied residency due to lack of substance (rare), different rules apply. Any reduced rate concession requires a valid HNTE certificate or free-zone approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 21-23 (Boxes 21-23) - Tax Credits and Actual Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax holidays, statutory exemptions, foreign tax credits, and other credits reducing the computed tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits for withholding taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income may be claimed with supporting Tax Residency Certificates, subject to the 5-year carryforward rule. Non-resident dividends received from after-tax Chinese profits are excluded from taxable income and are not to be double-taxed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Lines 24-25 (Boxes 24-25) - Quarterly Prepayments and Final Settlement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of quarterly provisional CIT payments against the annual computed liability, producing the final balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE failed to withhold WHT on an outbound dividend declaration during the year, that unpaid WHT is not settled on this return; the WFOE as withholding agent remains liable and must file a supplementary non-resident withholding return plus interest and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form A100000: Tax Collection Law Article 62 imposes RMB 2,000-10,000 penalty, or RMB 10,000-50,000 for serious circumstances. Understatement due to false accounts or fraudulent documentation: Article 63 imposes a fine of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax plus 0.05% daily overdue interest. If the WFOE fails to withhold non-resident WHT, Article 69 imposes a fine of 50%-300% of the unwithheld tax. Deliberate criminal tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201, where evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and exceeds 10% of the total taxable tax, can lead to imprisonment up to 7 years plus fines. Transfer pricing documentation failures expose the WFOE to SAPS estimation of taxable income, late payment interest, and penalties for failing to provide books and records.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% for dividends paid by a Chinese resident enterprise (including a WFOE) to a non-resident enterprise, imposed under CIT Law Article 37.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction, complete China's treaty benefit self-assessment declaration through the e-Taxation portal before the payment date, and submit beneficial ownership substantiation including charter documents, shareholding register, board resolutions, financial statements, bank records, and evidence of substantive business activity. The WFOE as withholding agent must file the Non-resident Enterprise Tax Withholding Return and may apply the treaty rate only after the competent tax authority accepts the declaration. All supporting documents must be retained for 10 years and, if not in Chinese, accompanied by a Chinese translation; failure to prove beneficial ownership results in the 10% statutory WHT plus interest and penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to statutory 10% CIT WHT, with treaty reduced rates commonly ranging from 5% to 10% depending on the recipient and beneficial ownership. Royalties for technology, patent, know-how, or trademark licences (common in robotic vacuum appliance manufacturing) are subject to statutory 10% CIT WHT, with treaty reduced rates commonly 5% to 10%. Value-added tax at 6% and local surcharges may also apply to cross-border royalties and qualifying services. Intercompany interest must satisfy the arm's-length standard and the 2:1 thin-capitalisation debt-to-equity ratio.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: For each fiscal year, a Local File is mandatory if any of the following related-party transaction thresholds are met in RMB: RMB 200 million or more for tangible property transactions (including IoT components, motors, robotic vacuum units); RMB 100 million or more for intangible property transactions (including patents and software); RMB 100 million or more for financial related-party transactions; or RMB 40 million or more for other related-party transactions. A Master File is required if the aggregate related-party transactions of the WFOE in a fiscal year reach RMB 1 billion or more.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not enact a separate 'Economic Substance Regulation' statute like some offshore hubs, but CIT Law Articles 41, 45 and 47, together with the Special Tax Adjustments Measures, require economic substance through the Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) doctrine. The WFOE must demonstrate real manufacturing facilities, employees, procurement decisions, inventory control, quality assurance, logistics coordination, and entrepreneurial risk-taking in China. A mere invoice-pipeline or shell WFOE used to channel profits to a treaty-shopping parent will have its treaty benefits denied and its transactions recharacterised under GAAR.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation / False Related-Party Invoicing / Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE sells robotic vacuum appliances to a foreign related party at prices 40% below independent wholesale levels, accumulates losses for five consecutive years, and fails to provide Local File or benchmarking documentation upon tax inquiry, shifting profit offshore while underpaying China CIT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 41 permits the tax authority to make TP adjustments; Article 44 allows default estimation of taxable income when documentation is absent. Tax Collection Law Article 63 imposes a fine of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax plus 0.05% daily overdue interest. Criminal Law Article 201 imposes criminal liability where evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and exceeds 10% of the total payable tax, with imprisonment up to 3 years for relatively large amounts and 3-7 years for huge amounts, together with fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who consciously designed or approved the sham pricing are directly responsible persons. Under Company Law Article 20 (and the 2023 revision Article 23) they may be forced to make civil restitution for losses caused to the company and creditors. The tax authority blacklists the legal representative on the Serious Tax Dishonesty List and notifies immigration to restrict exit; criminal conviction can result in personal asset forfeiture and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Non-Resident Withholding Tax Evasion / Mischaracterization of Distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The board declares RMB 80 million in dividends to the offshore holding company, fails to withhold and remit the 10% Chinese WHT, and wires the net amount abroad; alternatively, it pays cross-border royalties misdescribed as 'consulting services' to avoid royalty withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Articles 37 and 38 impose a 10% statutory WHT and make the WFOE the withholding agent. Tax Collection Law Article 69 imposes a fine of 50%-300% of the unwithheld tax, and the tax authority may recover the full tax from the WFOE plus daily overdue interest. If the mischaracterization is deliberately fraudulent, Criminal Law Article 201 applies with fines and imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and financial controller who ordered the wire transfer can be held personally liable for the unpaid withholding tax where fraud or abuse of the corporate form is established. The tax authority may blacklist them and enforce travel bans under Tax Collection Law Article 44. Criminal conviction for tax evasion may lead to personal asset seizure and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse / Treaty Shopping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE operates without any real physical office, manufacturing plant, employees, inventory, or bank-account substance; it is used solely to issue invoices and receive funds from related parties before passing profits to an offshore intermediary that claims treaty benefits on dividends or royalties without fulfilling beneficial ownership or business substance requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SAT Announcement 2015 No. 60 denies treaty benefits to non-beneficial owners. CIT Law Article 47 permits the competent tax authority to recharacterise the scheme under GAAR with a retroactive adjustment up to the statutory period for anti-avoidance. Tax Collection Law Article 63 imposes a fine of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax, plus interest. The tax authority may also disregard the offshore entity for tax purposes and assess the WFOE as the true profitable enterprise.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Chinese courts may pierce the corporate veil under Company Law and hold shareholders and directors personally liable for the unpaid taxes and civil debts of the shell WFOE. Directors' personal assets can be attached, and the legal representative is subject to travel bans and blacklisting. Where they have signed false financial statements or tax returns, they risk criminal prosecution for tax evasion with imprisonment up to 7 years and personal financial restitution.
